snippet.title: Anemorie - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
A girl with a fragile heart. A gift to see forgotten memories. Dive into Anna’s world, where every object holds a story—and one memory may change her life forever.

Anemorie is a visually captivating, story-driven adventure set in the 1990s, where you step into the life of Anna—a young woman navigating the complexities of self-discovery, love, and resilience. Living with a heart condition, Anna possesses a unique gift: the ability to glimpse memories embedded in cherished objects.
